extraction.Name: David Whiting
extraction.Refused/Protested: Yes I told the Farmer that I did not want the patent but he said it was issued and it had to be taken.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered at the Farmer's office in Okreek in 1917; sold land at $100 per acre; allottee satisfied with the sale; four children depend on him for support; document reference: 2a=/602.24; signed as David B. Whiting; notarized May 7, 1929 by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32
